reuse.why: Adds the closed-account check to the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard that every provider's link function already calls before touching data.

duplication.why: The check is written once and reaches all six provider link paths without copies.

placement.why: The pre-link guard in accounts/app.ts is the right layer, though the closed-account rule now lives in a function whose name only promises the already-linked check.

scope.why: Only the guard, one test block and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: Single small check in the shared guard is easy to own; renaming the guard (or splitting it) would make the extra rule discoverable.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount, linkEnableBankingAccount and linkFintegraAccount
